answer: An agent marketplace activates new identities at dawn only after each locks a fixed bond for 30 days. Creating names is cheap, but creating 1,000 active agents requires 1,000 bonds, tying up capital that cannot be reused during that period. This makes the marketplace a poor oasis for a sybil swarm: hollow profiles gain no access without the same deposit, so the attack scales with committed money, not free usernames.
